|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 4, in date order). It is the current text.
* '''Original''' ([[Emperor's Orders]], 22 June 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (23 June 2021). Players Committee card image, 22 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-D-emperorsorders-original.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/emperor's_orders.png Holotable commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images”], no mark). Text: “If you did not deploy an Objective, deploy on Executor. We're Not Going To Attack?: Your squadrons are destiny = 0. You may not deploy squadrons or non-Imperial starships. Unless you occupy a battleground site, Dreaded Imperial Starfleet is suspended. The Alliance Will Die...: Flagship Operations does not require any Executor sites on table to deploy. ...As Will Your Friends: At battleground systems where you have a piloted capital starship and a piloted TIE, your Force drains = 2. At sites related to systems you control, during battle may add one destiny to total power. If just lost, lose 3 Force.” '''What changed:''' (Published the day before the official release; the release-day images, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/aa06673 commit aa06673] of 23 June 2021, show the same card, so this is the original and not a Playtest version.)
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Emperor's Orders (Errata)]], 20 April 2022): Players Committee card image, 20 April 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-D-emperorsorders-2022.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/emperorsorders.png Holotable commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata”], no mark). Text: “If you did not deploy an Objective, deploy on Executor. We're Not Going To Attack?: Your squadrons are destiny = 0. You may not deploy squadrons or non-Imperial starships. Unless you occupy a battleground site, Dreaded Imperial Starfleet is suspended. The Alliance Will Die...: Flagship Operations does not require any Executor sites on table to deploy. ...As Will Your Friends: At battleground systems where you have a piloted capital starship and a piloted TIE, your Force drains = 2. If just lost, lose 3 Force.” '''What changed:''' art credit “jkno4u @ Deviantart.com” became “jkno4u @ DeviantArt”; copyright line now “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; the game text is re-wrapped; same words. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Emperor's Orders (Errata 2)]], 7 March 2026): Players Committee card image, 7 March 2026: 0 side [[:File:V15-D-emperorsorders.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23b4dc9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/emperorsorders.png Holotable commit 23b4dc9 “DS Errata”], mark “E1”). Text: “If you did not deploy an Objective, deploy on table. We're Not Going To Attack?: Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground system. You may not deploy non-Imperial starships. Unless you occupy a battleground site, Dreaded Imperial Starfleet is suspended. The Alliance Will Die...: Flagship Operations does not require any Executor sites on table to deploy, and does not target squadrons. ...As Will Your Friends: At battleground systems where you have a piloted capital starship/TIE pair, Force drains = 2. During battle at a site related to a system you occupy, may add one destiny to total power and/or re-circulate.” '''What changed:''' deploys “on table” (was “on Executor”); We're Not Going To Attack? now lets you, once per turn, ▼ a battleground system instead of making your squadrons destiny 0, and no longer bars squadrons; The Alliance Will Die... adds “and does not target squadrons”; ...As Will Your Friends now reads “piloted capital starship/TIE pair, Force drains = 2” and “During battle at a site related to a system you occupy, may add one destiny to total power and/or re-circulate”; “If just lost, lose 3 Force” is gone. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].

During battle at a site related to a system you occupy, may add one destiny to total power and/or re-circulate.” '''What changed:''' “If you did not deploy an Objective” became “If you did not deploy an Epic Event or Objective”.
